title: ophthalmophyllum rufescens
intro: Ophthalmophyllum rufescens, commonly known as the 'Pig's Ears', is a type of succulent plant belonging to the family Aizoaceae. The health benefits of Ophthalmophyllum rufescens include its ability to aid in wound healing and exhibit antimicrobial properties.
